weekLabel: Project 2 · Predict, Optimize, Decide · Eight-Slide Template

slides.title: Replace with the design decision
slides.subtitle: Student · prediction track · primary optimization family
slides.teaching: Template slide. Replace every prompt; do not add slides.

slides.title: 1 · Decision question and formulation

left.head: DECISION
left.body: Question · baseline design · why the decision matters

right.head: FORMULATION
right.body: Variables + units · objective · constraints · bounds · primary family and why

slides.teaching: Make the decision legible before software details.

slides.title: 2 · Evaluated prediction evidence

left.head: MODEL DIAGNOSTIC
left.body: Residual plot or confusion matrix · naive baseline · validation evidence · untouched final-test metrics

right.head: MODEL BOUNDARY
right.body: Features + target/label · train/validation/test roles · domain · manual check · strongest limitation

slides.teaching: Do not select a feature or threshold on the final test.

slides.title: 3 · Primary optimization and verified constraints
slides.callout: Show the solver result and tolerance-aware constraint audit—not a console screenshot.

slides.title: 4 · Fair solver or baseline comparison
slides.chartTitle: Replace with an objective-call or outcome comparison
slides.explainBody: Use the same bounded sub-problem, actual instrumented objective calls, feasibility result, and what the comparison does or does not validate.
slides.teaching: Replace demonstration values; include uncertainty across heuristic seeds when relevant.

slides.title: 5 · Show the predict–optimize–verify connection

steps.label: INPUT
steps.head: Candidate
steps.body: Variables stay inside the supported domain.

steps.label: MODEL
steps.head: Predict
steps.body: Frozen model returns performance or probability.

steps.label: SOLVER
steps.head: Search
steps.body: Prediction enters objective or modeled constraint.

steps.label: TRUTH
steps.head: Confirm
steps.body: Run the non-surrogate simulator, measurement, or expert check.

slides.teaching: Use project-specific function names and report surrogate-versus-truth discrepancy.

slides.title: 6 · Baseline versus recommended candidate

left.head: BASELINE
left.body: Comparable variables · surrogate prediction · truth-model result · one figure

right.head: RECOMMENDED CANDIDATE
right.body: Same variables and units · prediction · confirmed outcome · uncertainty and trade-off

slides.teaching: Use the same units and visual scale; a bound-hitting candidate needs special scrutiny.

slides.title: 7 · Bounded recommendation and next validation
takeaways: Replace with the confirmed decision recommendation.
Replace with the largest uncertainty or limitation.
Replace with the model/solver refusal boundary.
Replace with the next simulation, measurement, or expert review.
slides.teaching: Resolve the question without overstating certainty.
